title: Fix Rupee price decimal display and change 'Shop on Amazon' button to soft pink

requirements.summary: Fix Rupee price display formatting to show decimals correctly (e.g., Rs.1,399.00 instead of 139900) across all product display components
acceptanceCriteria: All product prices display with 2 decimal places (e.g., Rs.1,399.00 instead of 139900)
The Rupee symbol (Rs. or ₹) is shown before the price on every product card
Price formatting is consistent across ProductGrid, product cards, and any other product display components
No other product data fields are affected by this change

file_operations.description: Add a price formatting utility function (formatPrice) that divides integer paise values by 100 and formats them as Rs.X,XXX.XX with 2 decimal places. Apply this formatting to all price display locations within the ProductGrid component, including the product.price and product.mrp fields. Ensure the Rupee symbol (Rs.) appears before each formatted price. Update both the regular price display and any MRP/discount price displays to use this consistent formatting. Do not modify the underlying data structure or backend queries—only change how prices are rendered in the UI.

requirements.summary: Change 'Shop on Amazon' button color to soft pink with readable text and hover state
acceptanceCriteria: Every 'Shop on Amazon' button across all product cards is styled with a soft pink background color
Button text remains legible against the soft pink background
A hover state is applied that slightly darkens or adjusts the pink shade for visual feedback
No other buttons or UI elements are inadvertently affected

file_operations.description: Update the 'Shop on Amazon' button styling to use a soft pink background color (e.g., bg-pink-300 or a similar Tailwind soft pink utility class). Ensure the button text color provides sufficient contrast for readability (e.g., text-gray-800 or text-pink-900). Add a hover state that slightly darkens the pink shade (e.g., hover:bg-pink-400). Verify that only the 'Shop on Amazon' button is affected and that no other UI elements inadvertently change color. Test the button across all product cards to ensure consistent styling.
